ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels (RGB ~230-250) localized in central lobe regions, contrasted against 30% low-intensity black pixels (RGB ~10-30) concentrated at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white geometric fields occupy the central medial zones of both lobes. Solid black pigmentation bands delineate the leading edges and distal tips. Extensive high-frequency black-on-white mottling (stippling) is observed at the transition zones between the central white fields and the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the maximum vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-6 pixel) irregular serrations detected along the outer 60% of both lobe trailing edges; the topography becomes smoother/linear within the immediate proximity of the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curvature transitioning into acute, slightly upturned distal tips; leading edges exhibit a slight concave sweep towards the posterior.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of dark, sub-circular pixel groups (mottling) distributed across the lower-medial quadrants of both lobes, particularly dense near the notch interface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, parallel low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, oriented at a 40-degree diagonal angle, spanning approximately 15% of the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible diagonal linear rake marks on the left ventral lobe; minor pixel-level irregularity/notching on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated high-contrast black 'island' pixel cluster located within the white field on the posterior-medial border of the left lobe.
